top_signals.title: EGA CFO: Al Taweelah At Full Production by 1Q 2027
top_signals.summary: Emirates Global Aluminium says it’s making “strong progress” on restoring production at its main smelter, which was damaged in an Iranian strike earlier this year. It comes as the firm reported 9m revenue of $5.3 billion compared to $6.3 billion y/y. EGA’s CFO, Pal Kildemo spoke to Bloomberg’s Abeer Abu Omar on Horizons Middle East & Africa. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Talabat CEO: Grocery Demand Up Amid Mideast Situation
top_signals.summary: Food delivery giant Talabat reported its 3Q revenue jumped 18 percent to $1.2 billion. The Dubai-based firm says the growth is driven by robust demand during the summer and back-to-school periods. Talabat CEO Toon Gyssels spoke to Bloomberg’s Abeer Abu Omar on Horizons Middle East & Africa on the earnings. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Hidary: Investors See Anthropic IPO as Key Bellwether
top_signals.summary: Anthropic’s IPO is said to be about 6 times oversubscribed. The Claude AI Model firm and its co-founders are seeking to raise $64.4 billion in the public listing as well as $26 billion in private placement, making it bigger than Space X’s IPO. Jack Hidary, CEO of SandboxAQ spoke to Bloomberg’s Abeer Abu Omar on Horizons Middle East & Africa about the listing as well as his deals in the UAE on the sidelines of ADIPEC. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
